workspaces.Name: Design
workspaces.Tip: Solid, surface, freeform, NURBS and sheet metal modeling.

workspaces.Name: ECAD
workspaces.Tip: Electronic boards, component envelopes and enclosure integration.

workspaces.Name: Scan
workspaces.Tip: Meshes and reverse engineering. Print preparation is in CAM.

workspaces.Name: CAE
workspaces.Tip: Static structures, thermal conduction, natural frequencies and pipe-flow calculations.

workspaces.Name: Assemble
workspaces.Tip: Bottom-up assemblies: insert parts, joint them, test the motion and animate it.

workspaces.Name: Render
workspaces.Tip: Make realistic pictures: lighting, background and quality.

workspaces.Name: CAM
workspaces.Tip: Stock and work zero, milling, toolpath playback, external slicer paths and tooling inspection.

workspaces.Name: Script
workspaces.Tip: Write Python that builds and changes models. The editor sits beside the model; everything a script makes is one undo step.

tools.label: Home
tools.description: The home screen: your workspace folder, recent parts, new part.

tools.label: New
tools.description: Start an empty document.

tools.label: Open
tools.description: Open an Prism or STEP file.

tools.label: Save
tools.description: Save the document.

tools.label: Save As
tools.description: Save under a new name.

tools.label: Import File
tools.description: Bring in a file by its type: STEP, IGES, BREP, DXF (as a sketch), STL, OBJ, PLY or 3MF.

tools.label: Import STEP
tools.description: Bring a STEP (.step/.stp) model into the document.

tools.label: Import Mesh
tools.description: Bring in a scan or print file: STL, OBJ, PLY or 3MF.

tools.label: Export STEP
tools.description: Write all visible objects as a STEP file.

tools.label: Export IGES
tools.description: Write all visible solids and surfaces as an IGES file (.iges).

tools.label: Export BREP
tools.description: Write the exact geometry as an Open CASCADE BREP file.

tools.label: Export glTF
tools.description: Write a binary glTF (.glb) for viewers, games and the web: Y-up, metres, one colour per body. Exports the selection, or everything if nothing is selected.

tools.label: Export DXF
tools.description: Write the selected sketches (or every visible one) as a DXF of lines, circles and arcs, for laser, waterjet and CNC.

tools.label: Export 3MF
tools.description: Write a 3MF file for printing: keeps each body separate, in millimetres. Exports the selection, or everything if nothing is selected.

tools.label: Export STL
tools.description: Write a triangle mesh (STL). Exports the selection, or everything if nothing is selected.

tools.label: Export OBJ
tools.description: Write a Wavefront OBJ mesh.

tools.label: Export PLY
tools.description: Write a PLY mesh.

tools.label: Object
tools.description: Pick whole bodies, surfaces and curves.

tools.label: Face
tools.description: Pick individual faces.

tools.label: Edge
tools.description: Pick individual edges.

tools.label: Create Sketch
tools.description: Draw constrained curves on one or more planes in space. G positions the drawing gizmo; E edits curves; N looks normal.

tools.label: Edit Sketch
tools.description: Re-open the selected sketch: its geometry, constraints and dimensions are all still editable.

tools.label: Construction Plane
tools.description: Make planes: offset (one or a whole stack), angled, midway, square to a curve, or through three points. Sketch on them or use them as references.

tools.label: Intersection Curve
tools.description: The curve where two planes, faces or bodies cross each other.

tools.label: Look At
tools.description: Turn the view to look straight at the selected plane, face or sketch (or the sketch you are drawing).

tools.label: Box
tools.description: Create a rectangular solid.

tools.label: Cylinder
tools.description: Create a cylinder.

tools.label: Sphere
tools.description: Create a sphere.

tools.label: Cone
tools.description: Create a cone or truncated cone.

tools.label: Torus
tools.description: Create a torus.

tools.label: Extrude
tools.description: Push a sketch profile or face into a solid.

tools.label: Revolve
tools.description: Spin a profile around an axis.

tools.label: Edit Feature
tools.description: Go back into a feature you made (Extrude, Revolve, Fillet, Shell...) and change its numbers or picks. The model rolls back to just before it; OK puts it back and rebuilds the steps that came after. You can also right-click a step in the History.

tools.label: Hole
tools.description: Create plain or modeled threaded holes on a body or face, with blind or through-all depth.

tools.label: Fillet
tools.description: Round off selected edges.

tools.label: Chamfer
tools.description: Bevel selected edges.

tools.label: Union
tools.description: Merge bodies into one.

tools.label: Subtract
tools.description: Cut one body out of another.

tools.label: Intersect
tools.description: Keep only the shared volume.

tools.description: Translate objects.

tools.label: Mirror
tools.description: Reflect objects across a plane.

tools.label: Duplicate
tools.description: Copy the selected objects.

tools.description: Repeat objects along one, two or three directions.

tools.label: Circular
tools.description: Repeat objects around an axis.

tools.description: Repeat objects along a curve or edge chain.

tools.label: Fill
tools.description: Fill a face or closed sketch with copies.

tools.label: Table
tools.description: Place copies at positions from a table.

tools.label: Measure
tools.description: Measure sizes, distances and angles between faces, edges, bodies or points.

tools.label: Properties
tools.description: Volume, mass, center of mass and moments of inertia.

tools.label: Section Analysis
tools.description: Cut the model with a plane to see inside.

tools.label: Materials
tools.description: Open the material library: colors, finishes and engineering data you can apply to bodies.

tools.label: Import Image
tools.description: Bring in a picture to trace or measure against (PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF). It sits behind the model.

tools.label: Edit Image
tools.description: Change a picture's opacity, size, position, turn or mirroring.

tools.label: Set Scale
tools.description: Make a picture true size: click two points on it and say how far apart they really are.

tools.label: AR Export
tools.description: Export GLB and USDZ, choose real or tabletop scale, and share to a phone on your Wi-Fi.

tools.label: Stop Sharing
tools.description: Stop serving the AR page to phones.

tools.description: Select vertices, edges or faces and move them with the manipulator.

tools.label: Extrude
tools.description: Extrude the selected faces (or open edges), then drag the arrows.

tools.label: Insert Edge
tools.description: Add an edge loop through the selected edge.

tools.label: Subdivide
tools.description: Split every face into smaller faces for finer control.

tools.label: Select Loop
tools.description: Select the whole edge loop that runs through the selected edge.

tools.label: Select Ring
tools.description: Select the ring of edges side by side across the quads.

tools.label: Bridge
tools.description: Join two selected groups of open edges with a strip of faces.

tools.label: Freeze
tools.description: Lock the selected faces, edges or points so they cannot move (shown in blue).

tools.label: Unfreeze
tools.description: Release the selected points.

tools.label: Align to Curve
tools.description: Pull the selected points (or all) onto a curve: pick it in 'Curve to align to'.

tools.label: Weld
tools.description: Merge the selected vertices into one.

tools.label: Crease
tools.description: Make the selected edges sharp.

tools.label: Merge edges
tools.description: Remove the selected inner edges, joining the faces on either side.

tools.label: Unweld edges
tools.description: Split the form along the selected edges so each side can move on its own.

tools.label: Pull
tools.description: Pull the selected points (or all) onto the smooth surface the cage produces.

tools.label: Flip normals
tools.description: Reverse which side of the form is the outside.

tools.label: Mirror and weld
tools.description: Reflect the form across a plane and join the halves at the seam.

tools.label: Convert fewer faces
tools.description: Like Convert to NURBS, but each irregular face becomes one fitted patch instead of four: a lighter solid that is quicker for booleans and fillets, a little less exact near poles.

tools.label: Convert to NURBS
tools.description: Turn the selected form into exact NURBS surfaces / a solid for CAD operations.

tools.description: Turn the selected curves into reference (construction) geometry, or back into normal curves.

tools.description: Construction mode (X): while it is pressed, new curves are reference geometry. Click again to go back to normal drawing.

tools.label: Line
tools.description: Draw connected lines, or lines from their midpoint (options bar). Horizontal and vertical lines are detected and constrained automatically.

tools.label: Rectangle
tools.description: Draw rectangles. Choose 2-point, center or rotated 3-point in the options bar.

tools.label: Ellipse
tools.description: Draw an ellipse. Choose center, 2-point (a box it fits in) or 3-point (long axis, then the other radius) in the options bar. Hold Shift (or press L) for a circle.

tools.label: Arc
tools.description: Draw arcs. Choose 3-point, center or tangent in the options bar.

tools.label: Polygon
tools.description: Draw regular polygons. Choose inscribed or circumscribed and the number of sides in the options bar.

tools.label: Slot
tools.description: A slot: two arc centers, then the width.

tools.label: Spline
tools.description: Draw splines through fit points or shaped by control points.

tools.label: Trim
tools.description: Cut a line, arc or circle back to the curves that cross it. Click the part to remove.

tools.label: Extend
tools.description: Lengthen a line or arc until it meets the next curve. Click near the end you want to extend.

tools.label: Offset
tools.description: Copy a curve (or a whole connected chain) a set distance to one side. Select curves (Shift-click adds), press Enter to finish selecting, then move to a side and click, or type the distance and press Enter.

tools.label: Fillet
tools.description: Round the corner where two lines meet. Type the radius, then click the two lines.

tools.label: Chamfer
tools.description: Cut the corner where two lines meet with a straight edge. Type the distance, then click the two lines.

tools.label: Mirror
tools.description: Mirror curves across a line. Pick the curves, press Enter, click the line. Live mode keeps both sides symmetric.

tools.label: Pattern
tools.description: Repeat sketch curves along a direction or around a center. Choose linear or circular in the options bar.

tools.label: Horizontal
tools.description: Make a line horizontal, or line two points up horizontally.

tools.label: Vertical
tools.description: Make a line vertical, or line two points up vertically.

tools.label: Coincident
tools.description: Join two points, or put a point on a curve.

tools.label: Parallel
tools.description: Make two lines parallel.

tools.label: Perpendicular
tools.description: Make two lines meet at 90°.

tools.label: Tangent
tools.description: Make a line and circle/arc (or two circles) touch smoothly.

tools.label: Equal
tools.description: Make two lines the same length, or two circles/arcs the same radius.

tools.label: Midpoint
tools.description: Put a point at the middle of a line.

tools.label: Concentric
tools.description: Give two circles/arcs the same center.

tools.label: Collinear
tools.description: Put two lines on the same infinite line.

tools.label: Symmetric
tools.description: Mirror two points across a line.

tools.label: Fix
tools.description: Lock a point or curve in place.

tools.label: Dimension
tools.description: Drive sizes with numbers: lengths, diameters, radii, distances, angles. Options: smart, horizontal, vertical.

tools.description: Curvature comb: hairs along splines, ellipses and arcs that show how sharply they bend. An even comb means a fair curve.
